violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Lids missing from food containers in walk in cooler. Close box/bag of taco seasoning in BOH prep area. Store coffee and sugar away from refuse cans at customer service cabinets near coffee machines. Nacho cheese dispenser needs cleaning.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked Multiple items in walk in cooler not properly date marked.

Dispensing equipment - Design and construction. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not properly designed and/or constructed to prevent contamination. Ice machine has multiple damaged areas that need repair. Water pooling in bag used to wrap cover to ice machine. Nacho cheese dispenser broken and held together with packing tape.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. Multiple damaged/broken CAMBRO food service containers. Replace as needed.--Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Cabinet under dump sink at self service coffee station has water damage and is in need of repair.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Frazzle slushy machine has syrup build up and needs cleaning. Ice machine has build up and needs cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Wire rack shelving in walk in cooler and dunnage shelving in dish area have a build up of debris and need cleaning.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room used by women did not contain at least one covered waste receptacle.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors have a build up of food debris under line equipment and need cleaning. Ceiling in walk in cooler (Taco Express) has a build up of dust/mold and needs cleaning. Vent covers near cooking equipment in BOH prep area need cleaning.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Large holes in walls at hand sink and near 3 tub sink system.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Store wet mop in a position that allows proper air drying.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. Unlabeled chemical spray bottle on shelf above 3 tub sink system. Needs proper labeling as to contents.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Cover containers of chicken marinade and cooked ground beef in walk in cooler. Cover/close bags to 3 large boxes of spices in BOH prep area.--Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Boxes of food items stored on floor of walk in cooler.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Rusty wire rack shelving unit in walk in cooler, duct tape repairs to prep station cutting board rail, & packing tape repair to cheese dispenser case. Items not properly repaired.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Walk in cooler wire rack shelving and dry storage area shelving need cleaning. Cheese dispenser has food debris build up and needs cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors have a build up of dust and debris under prep line and BOH cooking equipment. Clean along wall junctures.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Hole in wall near hand sink, hole in ceiling above soda machine, & peeling wall panel in BOH prep area need repair.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Wet mop stored in utility sink. Store in a position that allows item to dry.
